optimizer: Adam, default betas and epsilon, weight_decay=0
preprocessing: pixels divided by 255; no augmentation; flatten for logistic regression
checkpoint_selection: minimum selection NLL, first epoch in a tie
temperature: minimize calibration NLL over log(T) in [-4,4]; keep T=1 if no improvement
ece_definition: top-label, equal-width bins, left-inclusive, final right-inclusive
brier_definition: mean over examples of sum over nine classes; range [0,2]
risk_definition: error rate on the accepted examples
ties: stable ascending original index; same tie-breaking rule before and after calibration
error_examples: ten errors ranked by raw CNN confidence; seed 0 for the main illustration; all seeds archived
